Monetary Policy Decisions – 2024

The Reserve Bank Board was responsible for formulating monetary policy. The Reserve Bank sets the target ‘cash rate’, which is the market interest rate on overnight funds. Decisions regarding monetary policy were made by the Reserve Bank Board and explained in a media release announcing the decision at 2.30 pm after each Board meeting. (Prior to December 2007, media releases were issued only when the cash rate target was changed.)

  • 10 December 2024
  • 5 November 2024
